aiResearchSummary.text: Juniper Networks is researching network optimization, security, and cloud-managed infrastructure. Work such as power optimization using dynamic bandwidth management between connected network devices and scalable multi-plane fabric-less connectivity for packet forwarding engine targets efficient, high-scale routing. Other efforts like intent-based enterprise security using dynamic learning of network segment prefixes and intelligent firewall policy processor focus on secure, policy-driven control. Additional innovations span SD-WAN, wireless access management, telemetry analytics, and optical interconnects.
